in_sanskrit.name: अनुभव
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: To experience, to perceive, to observe, to know, to feel.

in_hindi.name: अनुभाव
in_hindi.long_meaning: Anu Bhāvana - Feeling or experiencing in a deep sense.

in_tamil.name: அனுபவம்
in_tamil.long_meaning: Anu Pavaṃ - To experience, to perceive, to observe.

in_marathi.name: Anubhav
in_marathi.long_meaning: Anubhav हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Anubhav refers to the feeling or experience of something. It comes from the Sanskrit words 'anu' meaning 'with' and 'bhav' meaning 'feeling' or 'experience'. This name is often given to a child who is expected to have a rich and deep emotional life.
